title: Finiteness of Atypical Hodge Subvarieties
exact_target: For an irreducible smooth quasi-projective variety $S$ with a variation $V$ of mixed rational Hodge structures, is the atypical locus $S_{\mathrm{atyp}}(V)$ a finite union of maximal atypical subvarieties, equivalently a proper algebraic subset and hence not Zariski dense; and, in the generalized André–Oort case, does Zariski density of CM points force $V$ to arise by pullback from a connected mixed Shimura variety?
